description: This Java class defines a Fragment named SchedulerFragment used in an Android application to manage alarms. It handles displaying a list of scheduled alarms, adding new alarms via a TimePickerDialog, and receiving broadcasts when alarms go off to update the UI accordingly.

classes.name: SchedulerFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that manages scheduled alarms, allows adding new alarms via a time picker, and updates the UI when alarms go off.

methods.name: onActivityCreated
methods.description: Registers a BroadcastReceiver to listen for alarm off events when the activity is created.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the layout for the fragment.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes UI components, sets up RecyclerView with AlarmAdapter, the FloatingActionButton click listener, and the AlarmUtil instance.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Unregisters the BroadcastReceiver when the fragment is destroyed.
